articles.title: Officials Say Captain and Passengers Stopped Co-Pilot's Attempt to Crash FlyDubai Plane
articles.summary: Israeli officials say a FlyDubai co-pilot tried to crash a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight after stabbing the captain. Netanyahu said the injured captain opened the cockpit door so passengers and crew could overpower the attacker. The plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: Tennessee Halts Execution After Two Lethal Injections; Governor Orders Review
articles.summary: Tennessee halted the execution of Christa Pike on Wednesday night after two doses of pentobarbital. Governor Bill Lee has ordered a third-party review and canceled the other execution planned for later this year.

articles.title: Hegseth Announces 20% Cut to Generals and Admirals, New Robotics Command
articles.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth announced the military will cut 20% of its generals and admirals by Jan. 1, 2027, and create a new four-star command for autonomous and robotic systems. A Democratic and a Republican senator responded.
